mentions.note: 28th Surrey vets; led O.40 team to 6th, Southern vets; TVH relay B team 19.19; the p43 photo caption calls the first Belgrave man in the Southern O/40's 'Frank Barrett'; results print 'F.Barratt'

share.d: Fred Barrett in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1952–1983: 3 mentions in 3 issues and 3 race results.
